query:
SELECT id as "id!: i32", 
name as "name!: String", 
email as "email!: String", 
link_1 as "link_1!: String", 
link_2 as "link_2!: String", 
link_3 as "link_3!: Option < String >", 
note as "note!: String", 
invitation_id as "invitation_id!: Option < i32 >", 
status as "status!: WaitlistApplicationStatus", 
review_notes as "review_notes!: Option < String >", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime", 
reviewed_at as "reviewed_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >" FROM waitlist_applications WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR name = $6::text) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR name LIKE $8::text) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR name ILIKE $10::text) AND (NOT $11::boolean OR email = $12::text) AND (NOT $13::boolean OR email LIKE $14::text) AND (NOT $15::boolean OR email ILIKE $16::text) AND (NOT $17::boolean OR link_1 = $18::text) AND (NOT $19::boolean OR link_2 = $20::text) AND (NOT $21::boolean OR link_3 = $22::text) AND (NOT $23::boolean OR note = $24::text) AND (NOT $25::boolean OR invitation_id = $26::int4) AND (NOT $27::boolean OR status = $28::waitlist_application_status) AND (NOT $29::boolean OR status = ANY(CAST($30 as waitlist_application_status[])) ) AND (NOT $31::boolean OR review_notes = $32::text) AND (NOT $33::boolean OR created_at = $34::timestamptz) AND (NOT $35::boolean OR reviewed_at = $36::timestamptz) AND ($37::boolean IS NULL OR (($37::boolean AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $37::boolean AND reviewed_at IS NULL))) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($38 = 'Id' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Id' AND $39) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Name' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN name ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Name' AND $39) WHEN true THEN name ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Email' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN email ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Email' AND $39) WHEN true THEN email ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Link1' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN link_1 ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Link1' AND $39) WHEN true THEN link_1 ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Link2' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN link_2 ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Link2' AND $39) WHEN true THEN link_2 ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Link3' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN link_3 ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Link3' AND $39) WHEN true THEN link_3 ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Note' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN note ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Note' AND $39) WHEN true THEN note ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'InvitationId' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN invitation_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'InvitationId' AND $39) WHEN true THEN invitation_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'Status' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN status ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'Status' AND $39) WHEN true THEN status ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'ReviewNotes' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN review_notes ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'ReviewNotes' AND $39) WHEN true THEN review_notes ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'CreatedAt' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'CreatedAt' AND $39) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($38 = 'ReviewedAt' AND NOT $39) WHEN true THEN reviewed_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($38 = 'ReviewedAt' AND $39) WHEN true THEN reviewed_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $40 OFFSET $41 FOR UPDATE
